concurrency_and_state: SuperRankService.gI() and The23rdMartialArtCongressService.gI() use unsynchronized lazy singleton initialization.

SuperRankService.competing(Player, long) checks SuperRankManager.currentlyCompeting/awaitingCompetition/SPRCheck without locking, allowing concurrent requests to start duplicate matches for the same player, opponent, or zone.

The23rdMartialArtCongressService.startChallenge(Player) defers The23rdMartialArtCongress creation and manager.add(mc) by 500ms via GameLoopManager.gI().schedule while checking plCheck(player) and getMapChallenge(129) immediately, creating a 500ms TOCTOU window for duplicate challenges, zone collisions, and stale player/zone state.

WorldMartialArtsTournamentService.dangky_huy and regCheck mutate and read WorldMartialArtsTournamentManager.gI().listReg without synchronization, risking ConcurrentModificationException, double registration, or double refund.
SuperRankService.textInfoNew iterates pl.superRank.history and indexes pl.superRank.lastTime.get(i) without bounds check or synchronization.
cross_module_questions: Does SuperRank constructor deduct ticket/gem and handle a null Zone parameter when SuperRankService.competing case 2 passes getZone(113)?

What is the underlying collection type of WorldMartialArtsTournamentManager.listReg (e.g., ArrayList vs CopyOnWriteArrayList) and does the tournament manager clear/lock listReg at hour boundaries when canReg transitions?
Does Message.cleanup() tolerate being called twice on the same Message instance (as in SuperRankService.topList lines 119 and 128), or does it release a Netty ByteBuf twice?
Does Player.inventory.addGold(int) guard against exceeding Inventory.LIMIT_GOLD / int-to-long overflow when refunding tournament fees?

db_redis_touchpoints.safety_note: Synchronous DB read executed on caller thread AFTER rank/ticket/gem validation checks (lines 57-68), risking stale checks or overwriting in-memory superRank fields.
Synchronous DB query executed on Netty/caller thread when opening top-100 or challenge list.
Synchronous full player DB load executed on caller thread in competing() -> loadPlayer(id).

findings.impact: Players can convert Ruby (Hong Ngoc) into Gem (Ngoc Xanh) by repeatedly registering and cancelling tournament entry, or exploit fee differences if cancellation occurs in a different tournament hour.
findings.root_cause: Registration checks and deducts Gem+Ruby via checkGemAndRuby(gem)/subGemAndRuby(gem) (lines 158, 166, 200), whereas cancellation refunds purely Gem via player.inventory.addGem(gem) (line 213) and computes the refund from current getTournament() (line 205) rather than the fee originally paid.
findings.title: Ruby-to-Gem currency conversion and mismatched refund fee on tournament cancellation

findings.impact: Players can trigger duplicate 23rd Martial Arts Congress instances/fights for themselves or collide in the same arena zone, or start a match after disconnecting/leaving map 129.
findings.root_cause: startChallenge checks plCheck(player) and acquires zone immediately, then delays The23rdMartialArtCongress instantiation and manager.add(mc) by 500ms in setTimeout without reserving the player/zone or re-validating player online/map state inside the callback. Fallback loop in getMapChallenge also ignores z.getPlayers().isEmpty().
findings.title: 500ms TOCTOU race condition and zone collision in The23rdMartialArtCongressService.startChallenge

findings.impact: Concurrent challenge requests can create duplicate SuperRank matches for the same player/opponent/zone or corrupt waiting/competing lists; case 2 can pass null Zone into SuperRank constructor causing NPE.
findings.root_cause: competing() checks currentlyCompeting/awaitingCompetition/SPRCheck without synchronization before calling addSPR/addWSPR, and case 2 passes getZone(113) (which returns null when all zones are busy) directly to new SuperRank(player, id, ...).
findings.title: Missing lock/reservation in SuperRankService.competing and unchecked null zone in case 2

findings.impact: Validation can evaluate stale superRank data (rank, ticket) or loadData can overwrite current superRank state after checks pass.
findings.root_cause: SuperRankDAO.loadData(player) is invoked at line 70 after rank comparisons and ticket/gem checks at lines 57-68.
findings.title: SuperRankDAO.loadData(player) called after rank and ticket validation checks

findings.impact: ConcurrentModificationException, double registration (double fee deduction), or double refund when multiple threads access listReg concurrently.
findings.root_cause: WorldMartialArtsTournamentManager.gI().listReg is queried and mutated via contains/add/remove without synchronization around check-then-act sequences.
findings.title: Unsynchronized check-then-act on WorldMartialArtsTournamentManager.listReg

findings.impact: Server throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException or misroutes NPC menu selections (teleports to wrong map or teleports when clicking Close) if canReg is true outside 8h-23h.
findings.root_cause: getTournament() returns -1 for hours 0..7, but sayText() indexes tournamentNames[getTournament()], dangky_huy() indexes tournamentGolds[tour] without checking tour != -1, and confirm() cases 2/3 check if (canReg) without && tour != -1 unlike menu().
findings.title: Unchecked -1 tournament index and menu/confirm condition mismatch in WorldMartialArtsTournamentService

findings.impact: Blocks Netty/game threads during MySQL round-trips, stalling packet processing or map updates for other players.
findings.root_cause: NDVSqlFetcher.loadById, SuperRankDAO.loadData, and SuperRankDAO.getPlayerListInRank/Range are called synchronously inside service methods.
findings.title: Synchronous DB queries on caller/Netty thread in SuperRankService

findings.impact: Potential double-cleanup of Netty ByteBuf in topList, leaked Message on exception in sendTypePK, and missed SuperRankBuilder.dispose() on exception in topList.
findings.root_cause: topList calls msg.cleanup() in try (line 119) and again in finally (line 128), while dispose()/clear() are only in try; sendTypePK calls msg.cleanup() only in try without a finally block.
findings.title: Double Message.cleanup() in SuperRankService.topList and missing finally cleanup in sendTypePK

findings.impact: Silent failures mask runtime exceptions and leave players without feedback when arena zones are full; duplicated code increases maintenance drift.
findings.root_cause: Empty catch blocks in The23rdMartialArtCongressService (setTimeout, sendTypePK) and empty else branch when zone == null in startChallenge; duplicated case 0/1 blocks in SuperRankService.competing and duplicated fee/listReg block in dangky_huy.
findings.title: Empty catch/else blocks and duplicated tournament service logic

findings.impact: Potential truncation if player IDs exceed 32-bit int max or if SuperRank topList ever exceeds 127 entries; tournament gold fees stored in int instead of long.
findings.root_cause: Message writes (int) sb.getId() / (int) boss.id and byte list.size(); WorldMartialArtsTournamentService stores tournamentGolds[tour] in int.
findings.title: int narrowing on player/boss IDs, byte list size, and int gold variable

key_classes.name: SuperRankService
key_classes.responsibility: Handles Super Rank (Giai Sieu Hang) challenge initiation, top-100/opponent ranking UI packet (-96), DB player loading, reward text/amounts, and zone lookup.

key_classes.name: The23rdMartialArtCongressService
key_classes.responsibility: Initiates 23rd Martial Arts Congress (DHVT 23) solo challenges on map 129, schedules match start after 500ms, sends PK type subcommand, and allocates challenge zones.

key_classes.name: WorldMartialArtsTournamentService
key_classes.responsibility: Manages hourly World Martial Arts Tournament schedule, NPC menu/confirm dialogs, power-bracket validation, and gold/gem+ruby registration and cancellation.

module_summary: Tournament service layer (services.tournament) covering Super Rank PvP matchmaking/leaderboard, 23rd Martial Arts Congress solo boss challenge startup, and World Martial Arts Tournament hourly registration/NPC menus.

protocol_touchpoints.payload_summary: byte(0), UTF title, byte list.size(), per player: int rank, int (int)id, short head, [if session.version > 214: short -1], short body, short leg, UTF name, UTF status, UTF info
int (int)boss.id, byte 3 (set PK type against tournament boss)
